title: The Latest Crier for Mar 23, 2026
items:
Bouquet Making on Wednesday!

Join CAB this Wednesday for a fun evening of bouquet making paired with refreshing Lotus beverages! Stop by the Maytag BMW rooms anytime from 6:30–8:00 PM to create your own custom arrangement. We’ll provide paper for wrapping your bouquet, but feel free to bring a vase if you’d like to take your creation to the next level!

Paint your Reflection

Join SASA as we paint mirrors for a relaxating night to learn about SASA. We will be in the Maytag Atrium from 7-9pm on March 27th, feel free to stop by and paint a mirror for yourself. Learn more about what SASA is planning for the rest of the year as well!
